scope: Local synthetic staff reception, planned-task and task-scoped-hold workflow only. No owner-portal, physical-device, release, finance or operational acceptance claim.

checks.name: Official brand image and favicon load on the neutral sign-in page
Individual staff signs in through the local identity provider and VMMS API
Opted-in intake draft automatically saves later edits and recovers after refresh
Explicit unsubmitted tab draft survives refresh
Offline mode preserves form entries and blocks submission
Real intake and C02 persist on one work order through refresh
A proposed task persists and remains labelled planned after refresh
Protective hold is attributable to the selected task
Task-scoped hold and unrelated task remain distinct after refresh
Authenticated work-order layout fits 12 phone, foldable, tablet and desktop viewports; phone buttons meet 44 pixels
Staff workspace actions remain keyboard reachable with visible focus
Authenticated workspace respects the reduced-motion preference
Sign-out returns to entry and removes accessible VMMS tab drafts
No uncaught browser errors during the tested staff workflow
